owner_user_id.description: App user id of the developer who owns this key.

owner_callsign.description: Snapshot of the owner's callsign, for admin display without joining Users.

owner_name.description: Snapshot of the owner's display name/email, for admin display.

key_prefix.description: First ~12 characters of the raw key (e.g. rn_live_a1b2c3d4), plaintext, shown in lists so the owner can tell keys apart.

key_hash.description: SHA-256(pepper + raw key), hex. The raw key itself is never stored anywhere.

scopes.description: Reserved for future per-resource scoping; v1 keys always carry the single read:public scope.

total_requests.description: Approximate lifetime request count; updated on a throttled cadence, not per-request.

revoked_by.description: 'self' or the admin user id who revoked it.
